decisions.hidden_reasoning: Opponent is dragon-heavy; Sylveon is key. Bring Sylveon, Gholdengo, Kingambit? Garchomp lead for rocks... Sylveon handles dragons, Gholdengo blocks status, Kingambit. Lead Sylveon?

Dragapult almost certainly outspeeds my 149 Speed Gholdengo (its range goes to 213), and its Shadow Ball will easily KO my 66 HP Gholdengo before I move. My Shadow Ball can't reliably KO first. Kingambit resists Shadow Ball (Dark) and takes only ~20% from it, making it the safe pivot.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Gholdengo at 40.7% HP vs Dragapult. Shadow Ball is super effective (Ghost vs Ghost). Dragapult could outspeed and Shadow Ball KO? Gholdengo 66/162; Dragapult Shadow Ball with Life Orb? Item unknown. Dragapult SpA up to 167. Shadow Ball 80 BP SE vs 113 SpD... could do significant damage, maybe ~60-70%. Risky. Gholdengo's Shadow Ball vs Dragapult: 185 SpA, SE, Life Orb — likely big damage, possibly KO? Dragapult HP 163-195, SpD 85-139. Shadow Ball 80 BP SE with Life Orb: roughly 2HKO, maybe not KO. Make It Rain is 120 BP STAB but Dragapult isn't weak to Steel... actually Ghost/Dragon neutral to Steel. Shadow Ball SE is better.

Speed: Gholdengo 149 vs Dragapult 145-213 — could be outsped. If Dragapult outspeeds and Shadow Balls first, Gholdengo might die. But Gholdengo's Shadow Ball likely does ~70-100%? Let's estimate: 185 SpA, 80 BP SE, Life Orb 1.3x vs ~110 SpD, ~180 HP. Damage ≈ ((2*50/5+2)*80*1.5/... ) base: (22*80*185/110)/50 +2 ≈ (22*80=1760; *185=325,600; /110=2960; /50=59.2; +2=61.2; *1.5 SE=91.8; *1.3 LO=119; *random 0.85-1 = 101-119). That's over 180 HP? Wait HP 163-195. 101-119 damage vs ~180 HP = ~55-65%. Not a KO. Hmm, but Dragapult SpD could be lower (85): then damage higher: 1760*185/85=3830/50=76.6+2=78.6*1.95=153 → ~80-90%. Could KO if min SpD and max roll.

Dragapult's Shadow Ball on Gholdengo: SpA up to 167, Gholdengo SpD 113, HP 66/162. Damage: 22*80*167/113 = 293,920/113=2602/50=52+2=54*1.5=81*1.3=105 if LO. Gholdengo has 66 HP — dead. Even without LO, ~81 damage kills. So if Dragapult is faster, Gholdengo dies before attacking. Risky.

But wait — Gholdengo took Shadow Ball last turn and is at 66. Dragapult likely has LO or specs. If Dragapult outspeeds, Gholdengo dies. If Gholdengo is faster (149 vs max 213 — many Pult are max speed), likely Pult is faster. So attacking is risky.

Better: switch to Kingambit? Kingambit resists Shadow Ball? Dark/Steel — Ghost is SE against Ghost only; Kingambit Dark/Steel: Ghost hits Dark neutrally? Ghost is not very effective vs Dark? No — Ghost is neutral vs Dark... Actually Ghost is super effective vs Psychic and Ghost, and Dark resists Ghost? No: Dark resists Ghost (Ghost is not very effective against Dark). Steel neutral to Ghost. So Kingambit takes 0.5x from Shadow Ball. Kingambit is a good switch-in. Also Yawn is on Garchomp, not Pult.

But switching loses momentum; Dragapult could use status or set up. Alternatively, Gholdengo could Shadow Ball and hope to KO with high roll — but if slower, dies. Pult likely faster (typical max speed). So switching to Kingambit is safer: takes ~half from Shadow Ball, threatens with Sucker Punch/Kowtow.

Actually wait — Gholdengo's Good as Gold blocks status. Dragapult might Will-O-Wisp? Blocked. Dragapult could just Shadow Ball again. If Gholdengo stays and Pult is faster, Gholdengo dies. If Gholdengo is faster, deals ~55-90% and takes a hit back — could die to counterattack (66 HP, takes 81+). So staying likely loses Gholdengo either way unless KO roll.

Switch to Kingambit: Pult Shadow Ball does ~ (22*80*167/107... Kingambit SpD 107, HP 175): 22*80=1760*167=293,920/107=2747/50=54.9+2=56.9*0.5 resist=28.4*1.3 LO=37. ~37/175 = 21%. Fine. Kingambit then threatens with Sucker Punch (Pult likely attacks) or Kowtow.

Decision: SWITCH: kingambit.
